standard.name: Standard Round Table
standard.description: Balanced multi-round discussion, gradual divergence to convergence
standard.convergence_strategy: Opening views → Mid-round interaction → Deepen → Final round summary

brainstorm.name: Brainstorm
brainstorm.description: Encourage divergent thinking, collect as many ideas as possible
brainstorm.convergence_strategy: Ideation → Categorize → Filter → Optimize → Final roadmap
brainstorm.summary_scope: all ideas, categories, selected options, roadmap

debate.name: Debate
debate.description: Deep clash of opposing views, explore truth through argument and rebuttal
debate.summary_scope: core arguments, key disagreements, neutral moderator summary

review.name: Review Panel
review.description: Strict review, check feasibility, risk, resources, and impact
review.convergence_strategy: Dimension-by-dimension review → Final scoring and recommendations
review.summary_scope: dimension scores, consensus and disagreements, improvement list, overall conclusion
